title: Atomic Task Decomposition Skill — Input Schema

component_name.description: Name of the architectural component being decomposed.

component_description.description: Full description of what the component does, from Architecture.md.

files_affected.description: List of files this component is expected to create or modify.

description.description: What this file does within the component.

acceptance_criteria.description: PRD acceptance criteria that this component must satisfy.

estimated_total_complexity.description: Overall complexity estimate for the component before decomposition.

architecture_section.description: Optional reference to the Architecture.md section this component is defined in.
